content: {"kind":"plan","text":"按你说的睡前放松来排：先做仰卧的轻柔活动热身，再依次拉开久坐最容易变紧的髋前侧、臀部、大腿内侧和大腿后侧，最后用抱膝和扭转收尾。你没说场所，我按居家、难度1、15分钟排，全程没有力量动作，可以慢慢做完直接睡。","plan":{"schemaVersion":1,"source":"ai","title":"睡前开胯放松","summary":"15分钟居家睡前流程：轻柔活动热身、五个髋部拉伸、抱膝扭转收尾，全都躺着或坐着做。","goal":"relax","scene":"home","equipment":["mat","block"],"level":1,"targetMinutes":15,"avoid":[],"blocks":[{"id":"b1","name":"热身·唤醒髋部","type":"warmup","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"n-windshield","mode":"reps","sets":1,"reps":8,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"h-butterfly-active","mode":"reps","sets":1,"reps":10,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"n-leg-circles","mode":"reps","sets":1,"reps":6,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":10}]},{"id":"b2","name":"主训练·松开紧髋","type":"main","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"s-kneel-hipflex","mode":"time","sets":2,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":15},{"exerciseId":"s-figure4","mode":"time","sets":2,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":15},{"exerciseId":"s-butterfly","mode":"time","sets":2,"workSeconds":40,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":15}]},{"id":"b3","name":"放松·收尾","type":"cooldown","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"n-straddle-fold","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":40,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"h-knee-hug","mode":"time","sets":2,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"h-supine-twist","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":40,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":10}]}],"notes":["主训练和放松全是拉伸，睡前不安排力量动作；如果你觉得还有余力，可以把第二组拉伸多停留一会儿，而不是加动作。","半跪髋屈肌拉伸和坐姿分腿体前屈下面垫瑜伽垫或厚书，会更舒服。"],"safetyNotes":["全程在不痛的范围内停留，慢慢呼吸，不要弹振；不适加重就停止。","如果髋部出现刺痛、麻木或放射痛，先别练，建议咨询医生或康复师。"]}}
